duration.text: The Polymerscience at East China University of Science and Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4333 USD/per year ￥ 31200 CNY/per year

materials.text: Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents Recommendation letter from employer Personal Statement Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English. Undergraduate school transcript

requirements.text: 1. aged 18 or above; 2. be in good health; 3. ELTS 6.5 or TOFEL 80 (Internet-based) or GMAT will be preferred; 4. Bachelor's degree/diploma (English version) issued by accredited educational institution.
